rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Elementary and Secondary Education Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Elementary and Secondary Education Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Application for Approval of Establishment of Private School) ①person who intends to apply for approval of the establishment of a private school pursuant to Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit an application for approval of school establishment in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto to the Superintendent of Education of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Province, or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as the “Superintendent of Education”). In this case, the standards for facilities, equipment, etc., and the application procedures for approval as prescribed in the “ Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of High School and Below” and the “Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of High School and Below” shall be followed.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Application for Approval of Establishment of Private School) ① A person who intends to apply for approval of the establishment of a private school pursuant to Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall submit an application for approval of school establishment in accordance with Form No. 1 attached hereto to the Superintendent of Education of a Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Province, or Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as the “Superintendent of Education”). In this case, the standards for facilities, equipment, etc., and the application procedures for approval as prescribed in the “Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of High School and Below” and the “Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of High School and Below” shall be followed.

rows.source_ko: ② “Other documents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Education” pursuant to Article 3 , subparagraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree refers to documents classified according to each of the following subparagraphs.
rows.text_en: ② “Other documents prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Education” pursuant to Article 3 , subparagraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree refers to documents classified according to each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. Implementation status report on the annual supplementary plan for facilities to be supplemented after authorization pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School and the Annual Plan for Securing Educational Facilities and Equipment
rows.text_en: 1. rows.source_ko: 2. In cases where the entity intending to establish and operate a school is a corporation and falls under the proviso of Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the "Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School," a copy of the corporation's articles of incorporation and the relevant minutes of the board of directors meeting.
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where the entity intending to establish and operate a school is a corporation and falls under the proviso of Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the "Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School," a copy of the corporation's articles of incorporation and the relevant minutes of the board of directors meeting.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Application for Approval of Closure of Private School) An founder or manager of a private school who intends to apply for approval of school closure pursuant to Article 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for approval of school closure in accordance with Form No. 2 attached hereto to the Superintendent of Education. In this case, if the founder or manager is a corporation, a copy of the minutes of the relevant board meeting shall be attached.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Application for Approval of Closure of Private School) A founder or manager of a private school who intends to apply for approval of school closure pursuant to Article 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for approval of school closure in accordance with Form No. 2 attached hereto to the Superintendent of Education. In this case, if the founder or manager is a corporation, a copy of the minutes of the relevant board meeting shall be attached.

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Application for Approval of Change of Private School) ①An operator of a private school who intends to apply for approval of change pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for approval of school change in accordance with Form No. 3 attached hereto to the Superintendent of Education. In this case, the standards for facilities, equipment, etc. and the application procedures for approval as prescribed in the “Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School” and the “Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School” shall be followed.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Approval of Change of Private School) ① An operator of a private school who intends to apply for approval of change pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for approval of school change in accordance with Form No. 3 attached hereto to the Superintendent of Education. In this case, the standards for facilities, equipment, etc. and the application procedures for approval as prescribed in the “Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School” and the “Enforcement Rules of the Regulations on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School” shall be followed.

rows.source_ko: ② When applying for approval of a change of school location, the “related documents for change” to be attached pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree must include a plan for the change of school location pursuant to Article 6 of the “Enforcement Rules on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School.”
rows.text_en: ② When applying for approval of a change of school location, the “related documents for change” to be attached pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree must include a plan for the change of school location pursuant to Article 6 of the “Enforcement Rules on the Establishment and Operation of Schools of All Levels Below High School.”

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Joint Use of Administrative Information) Whenthe Superintendent of Education receives an application from the founder or operator of a private school pursuant to Article 2 , Paragraph 1 , Article 3 , or Article 4 , Paragraph 1, he/ she shall verify the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . If the applicant does not consent to the verification, the Superintendent shall require the attachment of the relevant documents (in the case of copies, they must be capable of verifying their authenticity by methods such as comparison with the original). However, if the applicant presents an identification card (referring to an identification card capable of verifying identity, such as a Resident Registration Card; hereinafter the same applies) when submitting the application, such verification may substitute for the verification of a copy of the Resident Registration Record. <Amended Dec. 1, 2017>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Joint Use of Administrative Information) When the Superintendent of Education receives an application from the founder or operator of a private school pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1, Article 3, or Article 4, Paragraph 1, he or she shall verify the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. rows.source_ko: Article 11 (Continuing Education for Acquisition of Teacher Qualification) Among the qualification standards to be met pursuant to Article 21 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)and Annex 1 and Annex 2 of the Act , continuing education (hereinafter referred to as “continuing education”) shall be conducted by classifying it as follows: <Amended Feb. 8, 2021>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Continuing Education for Acquisition of Teacher Qualification) Among the qualification standards to be met pursuant to Article 21 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and Annex 1 and Annex 2 of the Act, continuing education (hereinafter referred to as “continuing education”) shall be conducted by classifying it as follows: <Amended Feb. 8, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. Elementary School Teacher Training Course: A course to obtain the Regular Elementary School Teacher (Level 2) qualification.
rows.text_en: 1. Elementary School Teacher Training Course: A course to obtain the Regular Elementary School Teacher (Level 2) qualification.

rows.source_ko: 2. Special Education Teacher Training Course: A course to obtain the Regular Special Education Teacher (Level 1 or Level 2) qualification.
rows.text_en: 2. Special Education Teacher Training Course: A course to obtain the Regular Special Education Teacher (Level 1 or Level 2) qualification.

rows.source_ko: 3. Special School Administrator Course: A course to obtain the qualification of a special school principal or vice-principal.
rows.text_en: 3. Special School Administrator Course: A course to obtain the qualification of a special school principal or vice-principal.

rows.source_ko: Article 12 (Institutions Responsible for Continuing Education) Continuing education shall be implemented by the Superintendent of Education, provided that it is carried out by delegating or entrusting it to educational institutions, teacher training institutions, or educational research institutions.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Institutions Responsible for Continuing Education) Continuing education shall be implemented by the Superintendent of Education, provided that it is carried out by delegating or entrusting it to educational institutions, teacher training institutions, or educational research institutions.

rows.source_ko: Article 13 (Persons Subject to Continuing Education) Persons subject to continuing education shall be those who meet the qualification standards set by the Superintendent of Education ( or theMinister of Education in the case of national schools) among those who meet the qualification standards set forth in Annex 1 and Annex 2 of the Act.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Persons Subject to Continuing Education) Persons subject to continuing education shall be those who meet the qualification standards set by the Superintendent of Education (or the Minister of Education in the case of national schools) among those who meet the qualification standards set forth in Annex 1 and Annex 2 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: Article 14 (Continuing Education Curriculum) ① The continuing education curriculum shall be determined by the Superintendent of Education, and the educational subjects or educational areas to be included in the continuing education curriculum shall be as set forth in Attached Table 1 .
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Continuing Education Curriculum) ① The continuing education curriculum shall be determined by the Superintendent of Education, and the educational subjects or educational areas to be included in the continuing education curriculum shall be as set forth in Attached Table 1 .

rows.source_ko: ② In the continuing education course for persons falling under the proviso to Paragraph 1 , Paragraph 2, or Paragraph 3 of Article 15, some of the educational subjects or educational areas listed in Annex 1 may be omitted.
rows.text_en: ② In the continuing education course for persons falling under the proviso to Paragraph 1 , Paragraph 2, or Paragraph 3 of Article 15, some of the educational subjects or educational areas listed in Annex 1 may be omitted.

rows.source_ko: Article 15 (Continuing Education Hours) ① The continuing education hours for the elementary school teacher training course shall be 336 hours or more. However, the continuing education hours for those subject to continuing education who have at least one year of teaching experience in a secondary school may be 120 hours or more.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Continuing Education Hours) ① The continuing education hours for the elementary school teacher training course shall be 336 hours or more. However, the continuing education hours for those subject to continuing education who have at least one year of teaching experience in a secondary school may be 120 hours or more.

rows.source_ko: ② The continuing education hours for special school teacher training shall be 336 hours or more. However, the continuing education hours for those subject to continuing education who have at least one year of teaching experience in a special school (including special classes) may be 120 hours or more.
rows.text_en: ② The continuing education hours for special school teacher training shall be 336 hours or more. However, the continuing education hours for those subject to continuing education who have at least one year of teaching experience in a special school (including special classes) may be 120 hours or more.

rows.source_ko: ③ The continuing education hours for the special school administrator course shall be at least 180 hours. However, the continuing education hours for those eligible for continuing education who have obtained a master's degree in special education from a graduate school of education may be at least 60 hours.
rows.text_en: ③ The continuing education hours for the special school administrator course shall be at least 180 hours. However, the continuing education hours for those eligible for continuing education who have obtained a master's degree in special education from a graduate school of education may be at least 60 hours.

rows.source_ko: ④ The continuing education hours under paragraphs 1 through 3 may be divided and conducted separately.
rows.text_en: ④ The continuing education hours under paragraphs 1 through 3 may be divided and conducted separately.

rows.source_ko: 제16조(보수교육 성적의 산출 및 수료 등) ① 보수교육 성적은 보수교육 담당기관의 장이 정하는 바에 따라 산출하며, 만점의 60퍼센트 이상을 득점한 사람을 보수교육의 수료자로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Calculation of Continuing Education Grades and Completion, etc.) ① Continuing education grades shall be calculated in accordance with the standards set by the head of the continuing education institution, and a person who scores 60 percent or more of the maximum score shall be considered a completer of the continuing education.

rows.source_ko: ② 보수교육 담당기관의 장은 보수교육이 끝난 후 15일 이내에 보수교육 수료자의 명단을 보수교육을 위임하거나 위탁한 교육감에게 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The head of the institution responsible for continuing education shall notify the Superintendent of Education who delegated or entrusted the continuing education of the list of those who have completed the continuing education within 15 days after the continuing education is completed.

rows.source_ko: 제17조(수강료) ① 제13조에 따른 보수교육 대상자는 특별시ㆍ광역시ㆍ특별자치시ㆍ도ㆍ특별자치도(이하 “시ㆍ도”라 한다)의 조례에서 정하는 바에 따라 교육감에게 수강료를 내야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Tuition Fee) ① Persons subject to continuing education under Article 13 shall pay tuition fees to the Superintendent of Education in accordance with the ordinances of the Special City, Metropolitan City, Special Self-Governing City, Province, and Special Self-Governing Province (hereinafter referred to as “City/Province”).

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 수강료는 보수교육에 필요한 실비(實費)의 범위에서 정해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The tuition fee under Paragraph 1 shall be determined within the scope of the actual costs necessary for continuing education.

rows.source_ko: 제18조(보수교육 경비의 지급) 보수교육에 필요한 경비는 교육감이 보수교육 담당기관의 장에게 지급한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (Payment of Expenses for Continuing Education) The Superintendent of Education shall pay the expenses necessary for continuing education to the head of the institution responsible for continuing education.

rows.source_ko: 제19조(교육비 등의 지급) 교육감 또는 국립학교의 장은 예산의 범위에서 그 소속 교원(교육전문직원을 포함한다)에게 보수교육에 필요한 실비의 전부 또는 일부를 지급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Payment of Education Expenses, etc.) The Superintendent of Education or the head of a national school may, within the limits of the budget, pay all or part of the actual expenses necessary for continuing education to teachers (including educational specialists) affiliated therewith.

rows.source_ko: 제20조(수당 및 실비 변상) 보수교육을 담당하는 강사에게는 보수교육 담당기관의 장이 정하는 바에 따라 수당 및 실비를 지급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Allowances and Reimbursement of Actual Expenses) Instructors in charge of continuing education may be paid allowances and actual expenses as determined by the head of the continuing education institution.

rows.source_ko: 제1절 학교생활기록
rows.text_en: Section 1: School Life Records

rows.source_ko: 제21조(학교생활기록의 기재내용 등) ① 법 제2조에 따른 학교(이하 “학교”라 한다)의 장이 법 제25조제1항에 따라 같은 항 제1호부터 제6호까지의 자료를 학교생활기록으로 작성하는 경우 그 기재내용은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2020. 2. 28., 2024. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: Article 21 (Contents of School Life Records, etc.) ① Where the head of a school pursuant to Article 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “School”) prepares the materials specified in subparagraphs 1 through 6 of Article 25 , Paragraph 1 of the Act as school life records, the contents thereof shall be as follows: <Amended Feb. 28, 2020; Feb. 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 인적사항: 학생의 성명ㆍ주민등록번호 및 주소 등
rows.text_en: 1. Personal Information: Student's name, resident registration number, address, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 학적사항: 학생이 해당 학교에 입학하기 전에 졸업한 학교의 이름, 졸업 연월일 및 재학 중 학적 변동이 있는 경우 그 날짜ㆍ내용 등
rows.text_en: 2. Academic Records: The name of the school the student graduated from prior to admission, the date of graduation, and, if there were any changes to their academic status during enrollment, the dates and details thereof, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 출결상황: 학생의 학년별 출결상황 등
rows.text_en: 3. Attendance Status: Student attendance status by grade level, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 자격증 및 인증 취득상황: 학생이 취득한 자격증의 명칭, 번호, 취득 연월일 및 발급기관과 인증의 종류, 내용, 취득 연월일 및 인증기관 등
rows.text_en: 4. Status of Certificates and Certifications: Name, number, date of acquisition, and issuing body of certificates acquired by the student, as well as type, content, date of acquisition, and certifying body, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 교과학습 발달상황: 학생의 재학 중 이수 교과, 과목명, 평가 결과 및 학습활동의 발전 여부 등
rows.text_en: 5. Status of Academic Learning Development: Subjects completed during enrollment, subject names, evaluation results, and progress in learning activities, etc.

rows.source_ko: 6. 행동특성 및 종합의견: 학교교육 이수 중 학생의 행동특성과 학생의 학교교육 이수 상황을 종합적으로 이해할 수 있는 의견 등
rows.text_en: 6. Behavioral Characteristics and Comprehensive Opinion: Opinions that provide a comprehensive understanding of the student's behavioral characteristics during school education and the status of their school education completion, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제25조제1항제7호에서 “교육부령으로 정하는 사항”과 그 기재내용은 각각 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2020. 2. 28., 2024. 2. 28., 2025. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ② The “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Education” and the contents to be recorded in Article 25, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 7 of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended Feb. 28, 2020; Feb. 28, 2024; Feb. 27, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 학교정보: 학생의 재학 중 학년, 반, 번호 및 담임 교원의 성명 등
rows.text_en: 1. School Information: Student's grade, class, number, and homeroom teacher's name, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 학생의 수상경력: 학생이 중학교나 고등학교 교육과정(중학교나 고등학교에 준하는 교육과정을 포함한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다) 이수 중 수상한 상의 명칭, 등급ㆍ등위, 수상시기 및 수여기관 등
rows.text_en: 2. Student's Award History: The name, grade/rank, date of award, and awarding institution, etc., of awards received by the student while completing the middle school or high school curriculum (including a curriculum equivalent to middle or high school; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph).

rows.source_ko: 3. 학생의 창의적 체험활동 상황: 학생이 재학 중 실시한 자율ㆍ자치활동, 동아리활동 및 진로활동 등
rows.text_en: 3. Status of students' creative experiential activities: Autonomous and self-governing activities, club activities, career activities, etc. conducted by the student during their enrollment.

rows.source_ko: 4. 학생의 독서활동 상황: 학생이 중학교나 고등학교 교육과정 이수 중에 읽은 책의 제목 및 저자 등
rows.text_en: 4. Student's Reading Activity Status: Titles and authors of books read by the student during the middle or high school curriculum, etc.

rows.source_ko: 5. 학생의 자유학기활동 상황: 학생이 자유학기 중에 실시한 자유학기활동 결과
rows.text_en: 5. Student's Free Semester Activity Status: Results of free semester activities conducted by the student during the free semester

rows.source_ko: 6. 학교폭력 조치상황 관리: 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항에 따른 조치사항이 있는 경우 그 내용
rows.text_en: 6. Management of School Violence Measures: Details of measures taken pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence

rows.source_ko: 7. 학생의 일상생활 활동 상황: 「장애인 등에 대한 특수교육법」에 따른 특수교육대상자의 재학 중 의사소통, 자립생활, 생활적응, 신체 및 여가 활동 등 일상생활 활동 결과
rows.text_en: 7. Status of Students' Daily Living Activities: Results of daily living activities, such as communication, independent living, adaptation to life, and physical and leisure activities, during enrollment of students eligible for special education under the Special Education Act for Persons with Disabilities, etc.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항제6호에 따라 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제1호부터 제3호까지에 따른 조치사항에 관한 내용을 적어야 하는 경우는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우로 한정한다. 이 경우 제2호에 해당하는 경우에는 그 다른 학교폭력사건으로 받은 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제1호부터 제3호까지에 따른 조치사항에 관한 내용도 함께 적어야 한다. <신설 2020. 2. 28., 2024. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ The cases in which details regarding measures taken pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 1 through 3 of the Act on the Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence must be recorded pursuant to Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 6 shall be limited to any of the following cases. In such cases, if it falls under Subparagraph 2, details regarding measures taken pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 1 through 3 of the Act on the Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence regarding other school violence incidents must also be recorded. <Newly added Feb. 28, 2020; Feb. 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해당 학생이 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제1호부터 제3호까지에 따른 조치사항을 이행하지 않은 경우
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where the student concerned has not implemented the measures pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 1 through 3 of the Act on the Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 학생이 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제1호부터 제3호까지에 따른 조치를 받은 후 동일 학교급에 재학하는 동안(초등학생인 경우에는 그 조치를 받은 날부터 3년 이내의 범위에서 동일 학교급에 재학하는 동안) 다른 학교폭력사건으로 같은 조 제1항의 조치를 받은 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Where the student concerned receives measures under Paragraph 1 of Article 17 , Paragraph 1 of the Act on Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence for another school violence incident while attending the same school level (in the case of an elementary school student, while attending the same school level within a period of 3 years from the date of receiving such measures) after having received measures under Subparagraphs 1 through 3 of the same Act .

rows.source_ko: ④ 학교의 장은 학교생활기록을 학교생활기록부와 학교생활 세부사항기록부로 구분해 작성ㆍ관리한다. 이 경우 학교생활 세부사항기록부는 학생의 상급학교(「고등교육법」 제2조 각 호에 따른 학교를 포함한다. 이하 이 항에서 같다) 진학지도 및 상급학교 학생선발에 활용하기 위해 제1항 및 제3항에 관한 사항이 전부 포함되도록 작성ㆍ관리한다. <개정 2020. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: ④ The head of the school shall prepare and manage school life records by classifying them into a School Life Record Book and a School Life Detailed Record Book. In this case, the School Life Detailed Record Book shall be prepared and managed to include all matters concerning Paragraphs 1 and 3 in order to be utilized for guidance on advancement to higher schools (including schools under each subparagraph of Article 2 of the Higher Education Act; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph) and for student selection by higher schools. <Amended Feb. 28, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항부터 제4항까지의 규정에도 불구하고 공민학교ㆍ고등공민학교ㆍ고등기술학교ㆍ특수학교 및 각종학교의 장은 해당 학교의 학칙으로 정하는 바에 따라 학교생활기록을 해당 학교의 교육과정에 알맞게 수정해 작성ㆍ관리할 수 있다. <개정 2020. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Notwithstanding the provisions of Paragraphs 1 through 4, the heads of civic schools, higher civic schools, higher technical schools, special schools, and various other schools may modify, compile, and manage school life records in accordance with the school's curriculum as prescribed by the school's regulations. <Amended Feb. 28, 2020>
[Wholly revised Mar. 11, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제22조(학교생활기록의 관리ㆍ보존 등) ① 학교의 장은 「공공기록물 관리에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에 따라 학교생활기록부 및 학교생활 세부사항기록부를 관리ㆍ보존해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 22 (Management and Preservation of School Life Records, etc.) ① The head of a school shall manage and preserve school life records and detailed school life records in accordance with the Public Records Management Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act.

rows.source_ko: ② 학교의 장은 학교생활기록의 기록 사항 중 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제1호부터 제3호까지의 조치사항을 해당 학생의 졸업과 동시에 삭제해야 한다. <개정 2022. 9. 23., 2024. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② The head of the school shall delete from the school life records the matters concerning measures under Article 17, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 1 through 3 of the Act on the Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence simultaneously with the graduation of the relevant student. <Amended Sep. 23, 2022; Feb. 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ③ 학교의 장은 학교생활기록의 기록 사항 중 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제4호부터 제8호까지의 조치사항을 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 기간이 지난 후에 지체 없이 삭제해야 한다. 다만, 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제4호부터 제7호까지의 조치사항은 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 해당 학생이 졸업하기 직전에 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제14조제3항에 따른 전담기구의 심의를 거쳐 해당 학생의 졸업과 동시에 삭제할 수 있다. <개정 2020. 2. 28., 2022. 9. 23., 2024. 2. 28.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the school shall delete, without delay, the measures specified in Article 17, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 4 through 8 of the Act on the Prevention of and Countermeasures against School Violence from the records of school life after the period specified in each of the following subparagraphs has elapsed. However, the measures specified in Article 17, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 4 through 7 of the Act on the Prevention of and Countermeasures against School Violence may be deleted simultaneously with the graduation of the student concerned, immediately before the student’s graduation, following deliberation by the dedicated body pursuant to Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Act on the Prevention of and Countermeasures against School Violence, as determined by the Minister of Education. <Amended Feb. 28, 2020; Sep. 23, 2022; Feb. 28, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제4호 및 제5호의 조치사항: 해당 학생이 졸업한 날부터 2년
rows.text_en: 1. Measures under Article 17, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 4 and 5 of the Act on the Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence : 2 years from the date the student concerned graduates

rows.source_ko: 2. 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제6호부터 제8호까지의 조치사항: 해당 학생이 졸업한 날부터 4년
rows.text_en: 2. Measures under Article 17, Paragraph 1 , Subparagraphs 6 through 8 of the Act on the Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence : 4 years from the date the student concerned graduates

rows.source_ko: ④ 학년도별 학교생활기록의 작성이 종료된 이후에는 해당 학교생활기록의 내용을 정정할 수 없다. 다만, 정정을 위한 객관적인 증명자료가 있는 경우에는 정정할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ Once the school life record for each academic year has been completed, the contents of the relevant school life record cannot be corrected. However, if there is objective supporting evidence for the correction, it may be corrected.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제2항 및 제3항에 따라 학교생활기록의 기록 사항 중 「학교폭력예방 및 대책에 관한 법률」 제17조제1항제1호부터 제8호까지의 조치사항을 삭제하는 방법 및 절차에 관하여 필요한 사항은 교육부장관이 정한다. <신설 2025. 4. 28.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Minister of Education shall determine the necessary matters concerning the method and procedure for deleting the measures specified in Article 17, Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1 through 8 of the Act on the Prevention and Countermeasures against School Violence from the items recorded in the school life records pursuant to Paragraphs 2 and 3. <Newly added Apr. 28, 2025>
[Wholly revised Mar. 11, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제23조(학교생활기록 작성ㆍ관리 실태 점검) ① 학교의 장은 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 학교생활기록의 작성ㆍ관리 실태를 점검해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 23 (Inspection of the Status of Preparation and Management of School Life Records) ① The head of a school shall inspect the status of preparation and management of school life records in accordance with the provisions of the Minister of Education.

rows.source_ko: ② 교육감은 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 관할 학교의 학교생활기록 작성ㆍ관리 실태를 점검해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Superintendent of Education shall inspect the status of the preparation and management of school life records at schools under their jurisdiction as determined by the Minister of Education .
[Wholly revised Mar. 11, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제24조(학업성적관리위원회의 설치ㆍ운영) 학교의 장은 학교생활기록의 작성ㆍ관리 관련 업무의 공정하고 적정한 처리를 위해 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 학업성적관리위원회를 설치ㆍ운영해야 한다. 다만, 공민학교ㆍ고등공민학교ㆍ고등기술학교ㆍ특수학교 및 각종학교의 장은 학업성적관리위원회를 설치ㆍ운영하지 않을 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 24 (Establishment and Operation of Academic Performance Management Committee) The head of a school shall establish and operate an Academic Performance Management Committee in accordance with the provisions of the Minister of Education for the fair and proper handling of matters related to the creation and management of school life records. However, the heads of civic schools, higher civic schools, higher technical schools, special schools, and various other schools may not establish and operate an Academic Performance Management Committee.
[Wholly revised Mar. 11, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제25조(학교생활기록 작성ㆍ관리 세부지침) 제21조부터 제24조까지의 규정에서 정한 사항 외에 학교생활기록 작성ㆍ관리 등에 필요한 사항은 교육부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 25 (Detailed Guidelines for the Preparation and Management of School Life Records) Matters necessary for the preparation and management of school life records, etc., in addition to the matters stipulated in Articles 21 through 24, shall be determined by the Minister of Education .
[Wholly revised Mar. 11, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제2절 학력인정
rows.text_en: Section 2. Recognition of Academic Qualifications

rows.source_ko: 제26조(검정고시위원회의 설치) ① 영 제96조제2항에 따른 초등학교 졸업학력 검정고시(이하 “초졸검정고시”라 한다), 영 제97조제2항에 따른 중학교 졸업학력 검정고시(이하 “중졸검정고시”라 한다) 및 영 제98조제2항에 따른 고등학교 졸업학력 검정고시(이하 “고졸검정고시”라 한다)를 시행하기 위하여 교육감 소속으로 검정고시위원회를 둔다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 26 (Establishment of the Equivalency Examination Committee) ① The Equivalency Examination Committee shall be established under the jurisdiction of the Superintendent of Education to administer the Elementary School Graduation Equivalency Examination pursuant to Article 96, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “Elementary School Equivalency Examination”), the Middle School Graduation Equivalency Examination pursuant to Article 97, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “Middle School Equivalency Examination”), and the High School Graduation Equivalency Examination pursuant to Article 98, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (hereinafter referred to as the “High School Equivalency Examination”). <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 검정고시위원회는 다음 각 호의 사항을 관장한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The Higher Education and Equivalency Examination Committee shall have jurisdiction over the following matters. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 초졸검정고시, 중졸검정고시 및 고졸검정고시(이하 “검정고시”라 한다)의 공고, 응시원서의 접수 및 검정고시의 시행
rows.text_en: 1. Announcement of the Elementary School Equivalency Examination, Middle School Equivalency Examination, and High School Equivalency Examination (hereinafter referred to as the “Equity Examination”), acceptance of application forms, and implementation of the Equivalency Examination

rows.source_ko: 2. 출제, 채점 및 합격증 발급
rows.text_en: 2. Question setting, grading, and issuance of certificates of passing

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 검정고시의 시행에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters necessary for the implementation of the GED

rows.source_ko: 제27조(검정고시위원회의 구성 및 출제위원 등의 위촉) ① 검정고시위원회는 위원장 1명과 부위원장 1명을 포함하여 7명의 위원으로 구성한다.
rows.text_en: Article 27 (Composition of the Higher Education Examination Committee and Appointment of Examiners, etc.) ① The Higher Education Examination Committee shall be composed of seven members, including one chairperson and one vice-chairperson.

rows.source_ko: ② 위원장은 교육감이 되고, 부위원장은 부교육감이 된다.
rows.text_en: ② The chairperson shall be the Superintendent of Education, and the vice-chairperson shall be the Deputy Superintendent of Education.

rows.source_ko: ③ 위원은 검정고시를 시행할 때마다 해당 교육감 소속 공무원 중에서 위원장이 임명한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The chairperson shall appoint members from among public officials under the jurisdiction of the relevant superintendent of education whenever the GED examination is administered.

rows.source_ko: ④ 검정고시위원회는 검정고시를 시행할 때마다 해당 교육감 소속 공무원 또는 검정고시과목에 관한 학식이 풍부한 사람 중에서 출제위원, 채점위원 및 시험감독관을 임명하거나 위촉한다. <개정 2021. 2. 8.>
rows.text_en: ④ Whenever the Equivalency Examination Committee administers the Equivalency Examination, it shall appoint or commission question setters, graders, and examination supervisors from among public officials under the jurisdiction of the relevant Superintendent of Education or persons with extensive knowledge regarding the subjects of the Equivalency Examination. <Amended Feb. 8, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제28조(위원장의 직무 등) ① 위원장은 검정고시위원회를 대표하고, 검정고시위원회의 업무를 총괄한다.
rows.text_en: Article 28 (Duties of the Chairperson, etc.) ① The Chairperson represents the Higher Education Examination Committee and oversees the overall affairs of the Higher Education Examination Committee.

rows.source_ko: ② 부위원장은 위원장을 보좌하며, 위원장이 부득이한 사유로 그 직무를 수행할 수 없을 때에는 그 직무를 대행한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Vice Chairperson assists the Chairperson and acts on behalf of the Chairperson when the Chairperson is unable to perform their duties due to unavoidable circumstances.

rows.source_ko: ③ 위원은 위원장의 명을 받아 검정고시에 관한 사항을 담당한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Members shall be in charge of matters concerning the qualification examination under the direction of the chairperson.

rows.source_ko: 제29조(회의) ① 위원장은 검정고시위원회의 회의를 소집하고, 그 의장이 된다.
rows.text_en: Article 29 (Meetings) ① The Chairperson shall convene meetings of the Higher Education Examination Committee and preside over them.

rows.source_ko: ② 검정고시위원회의 회의는 재적위원 과반수의 출석으로 개의(開議)하고, 출석위원 과반수의 찬성으로 의결한다.
rows.text_en: ② Meetings of the Higher Education Examination Committee shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of the registered members and decisions shall be made by the approval of a majority of the members present.

rows.source_ko: 제30조(간사와 서기) ① 검정고시위원회에 각각 간사 1명과 서기 1명을 둔다.
rows.text_en: Article 30 (Secretary and Clerk) ① The Examination Committee shall have one secretary and one clerk.

rows.source_ko: ② 간사와 서기는 해당 교육감 소속 공무원 중에서 위원장이 지명한다.
rows.text_en: ② The chairperson shall appoint the secretary and the clerk from among the public officials under the jurisdiction of the relevant superintendent of education.

rows.source_ko: ③ 간사는 위원장의 명을 받아 검정고시위원회의 서무를 처리하고, 서기는 간사를 보조한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The secretary handles the administrative affairs of the General Examination Committee under the orders of the chairperson, and the clerk assists the secretary.

rows.source_ko: 제31조(수당과 여비) 검정고시위원회의 위원과 출제위원, 채점위원 및 시험감독관에게는 예산의 범위에서 수당과 여비를 지급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 31 (Allowances and Travel Expenses) Members of the Higher Education Examination Committee, question setters, graders, and examination supervisors may be paid allowances and travel expenses within the limits of the budget.

rows.source_ko: 제32조(검정고시의 시행 및 공고) ① 검정고시위원회는 연 2회 이상 검정고시를 시행하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 32 (Implementation and Announcement of the Higher Education Examination) ① The Higher Education Examination Committee shall conduct the Higher Education Examination at least twice a year.

rows.source_ko: ② 검정고시위원회는 다른 교육감 소속 검정고시위원회와 공동으로 검정고시를 시행할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The GED Committee may conduct the GED jointly with the GED Committee under the jurisdiction of another Superintendent of Education.

rows.source_ko: ③ 검정고시위원회는 검정고시를 시행하기 2개월 전에 시험의 일시ㆍ장소, 원서접수, 그 밖에 검정고시의 시행에 관한 사항을 공고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Board of Eligibility for Higher Education shall announce the date and time, location of the examination, application acceptance, and other matters concerning the implementation of the examination two months prior to the examination.

rows.source_ko: 제33조(시험과목) ① 초졸검정고시의 시험과목은 별표 1의2와 같다. <신설 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 33 (Examination Subjects) ① The examination subjects for the Elementary School Equivalency Examination are as set forth in Attached Table 1-2. <Newly added Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 중졸검정고시의 시험과목은 별표 2와 같다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② The subjects for the Middle School Equivalency Examination are as set forth in Attached Table 2. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③ 고졸검정고시의 시험과목은 별표 3과 같다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ The subjects for the High School Equivalency Examination are as set forth in Attached Table 3. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제34조(시험방법 등) 검정고시는 객관식 필기시험으로 하고 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 다음 각 호에 따른 지식과 응용능력을 검정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 34 (Test Methods, etc.) The qualification examination shall be a multiple-choice written test and shall assess knowledge and application ability according to the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 초졸검정고시: 초등학교 졸업 정도의 지식과 그 응용능력
rows.text_en: 1. Elementary School Equivalency Exam: Knowledge equivalent to an elementary school diploma and the ability to apply it

rows.source_ko: 2. 중졸검정고시: 중학교 졸업 정도의 지식과 그 응용능력
rows.text_en: 2. Middle School Equivalency Exam: Knowledge equivalent to a middle school diploma and the ability to apply it

rows.source_ko: 3. 고졸검정고시: 고등학교 졸업 정도의 지식과 그 응용능력
rows.text_en: 3. High School Equivalency Exam: Knowledge equivalent to a high school diploma and the ability to apply it
[Wholly Amended Sep. 25, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제35조(응시자격) ① 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람은 초졸검정고시에 응시할 수 있다. <신설 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 35 (Eligibility for Examination) ① Any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs may take the Elementary School Equivalency Examination. <Newly added Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 응시하려는 초졸검정고시가 시행되는 해의 전(前)년도를 기준으로 만 11세 이상인 사람
rows.text_en: 1. Persons aged 11 or older based on the year preceding the year in which the elementary school equivalency exam to be taken is administered.

rows.source_ko: 2. 「보호소년 등의 처우에 관한 법률 시행령」제69조 제1호에 해당하는 사람
rows.text_en: 2. Persons falling under Article 69, Item 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Treatment of Juveniles under Protection, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 초등학교를 졸업하였거나 재학 중인 사람(영 제29조에 따라 학적이 정원 외로 관리되는 사람은 제외한다)은 초졸검정고시에 응시할 수 없다. <신설 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, persons who have graduated from or are currently enrolled in elementary school ( excluding persons whose school records are managed outside the quota pursuant to Article 29 of the Enforcement Decree) are not eligible to take the elementary school equivalency examination. <Newly added Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③ 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람은 중졸검정고시에 응시할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ Any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs may take the middle school equivalency examination. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 초등학교 졸업자 및 이와 같은 수준 이상의 학력이 있다고 인정된 사람
rows.text_en: 1. Elementary school graduates and persons recognized as having an equivalent or higher level of education.

rows.source_ko: 2. 3년제 고등공민학교 졸업자 또는 졸업예정자(최종학년에 재학 중인 사람을 말한다. 이하 같다)
rows.text_en: 2. Graduates or prospective graduates of a three-year higher civic school (referring to those currently enrolled in their final year; hereinafter the same applies)

rows.source_ko: 3. 중학교에 준하는 각종학교의 졸업자 또는 졸업예정자
rows.text_en: 3. Graduates or prospective graduates of various schools equivalent to middle school

rows.source_ko: 4. 「보호소년 등의 처우에 관한 법률 시행령」 제69조제2호에 해당하는 사람
rows.text_en: 4. Persons falling under Article 69, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Treatment of Juveniles under Protection, etc.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에도 불구하고 중학교 또는 영 제97조제1항제2호의 학교를 졸업하였거나 재학 중인 사람(영 제29조에 따라 학적이 정원 외로 관리되는 사람은 제외한다)은 중졸검정고시에 응시할 수 없다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ Notwithstanding Paragraph 3, persons who have graduated from or are currently enrolled in a middle school or a school specified in Article 97 , Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (excluding persons whose academic records are managed outside the quota pursuant to Article 29 of the Enforcement Decree) may not take the Middle School Equivalency Examination. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람은 고졸검정고시에 응시할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs may take the high school equivalency examination. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중학교 졸업자 및 이와 같은 수준 이상의 학력이 있다고 인정된 사람
rows.text_en: 1. Middle school graduates and persons recognized as having an equivalent or higher level of education.

rows.source_ko: 2. 「1945년 이후 종전의 규정에 의한 학교 졸업자 자격인정령」 제1조 또는 제2조에 해당하는 사람
rows.text_en: 2. Persons falling under Article 1 or 2 of the “Ordinance on the Recognition of Qualifications of School Graduates under the Former Regulations Since 1945”

rows.source_ko: 3. 고등학교에 준하는 각종학교의 졸업자 또는 졸업예정자
rows.text_en: 3. Graduates or prospective graduates of various schools equivalent to high school

rows.source_ko: 4. 종전의 「근로자직업훈련촉진법」에 따라 중학교 졸업자 또는 이와 같은 수준 이상의 학력이 있는 사람을 대상으로 하는 3년제 직업훈련과정(이하 “3년제직업훈련과정”이라 한다)의 수료자
rows.text_en: 4. Persons who have completed a 3-year vocational training course (hereinafter referred to as the “3-year vocational training course”) subject to middle school graduates or persons with an equivalent or higher level of education under the former “Worker Vocational Training Promotion Act.”

rows.source_ko: 5. 「보호소년 등의 처우에 관한 법률 시행령」 제69조제3호에 해당하는 사람
rows.text_en: 5. Persons falling under Article 69, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Treatment of Juveniles under Protection, etc.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제5항에도 불구하고 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사람은 고졸검정고시에 응시할 수 없다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Notwithstanding Paragraph 5, any person falling under any of the following subparagraphs shall not be eligible to take the High School Equivalency Examination. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 고등학교 또는 영 제98조제1항제2호의 학교를 졸업하였거나 재학 중인 사람(「장애인 등에 대한 특수교육법」에 따라 특수교육대상자 중 학적이 정원 외로 관리되는 사람은 제외한다)
rows.text_en: 1. Persons who have graduated from or are currently enrolled in a high school or a school specified in Article 98, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree (excluding persons eligible for special education whose academic records are managed outside the quota pursuant to the Special Education Act for Persons with Disabilities, etc. )

rows.source_ko: 2. 고등학교 또는 영 제98조제1항제2호의 학교에서 퇴학된 사람으로서 퇴학일부터 제32조제3항에 따른 공고일까지의 기간이 6개월 이상이 되지 않은 사람. 다만, 「장애인복지법」 제32조에 따라 등록한 장애인으로서 신체적ㆍ정신적 장애로 학업을 계속하는 것이 불가능하여 퇴학된 사람은 제외한다.
rows.text_en: 2. A person who has been expelled from a high school or a school under Article 98, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, and for whom the period from the date of expulsion to the date of public notice under Article 32 , Paragraph 3 is not six months or longer. However, a person who is a person with a disability registered under Article 32 of the "Disability Welfare Act" and has been expelled because it is impossible to continue their studies due to a physical or mental disability shall be excluded.

rows.source_ko: 제36조(응시원서 등) ① 초졸검정고시에 응시하려는 사람은 별지 제3호의2서식에 따른 초등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 응시원서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 검정고시위원회의 위원장에게 제출하여야 한다. <신설 2015. 9. 25., 2017. 12. 1., 2024. 11. 14.>
rows.text_en: Article 36 (Application Form, etc.) ① Any person who intends to take the Elementary School Graduation Equivalency Examination shall submit an application form for the Elementary School Graduation Equivalency Examination in accordance with Form No. 3-2 of the Attached Form to the Chairperson of the Equivalency Examination Committee, attaching the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. <Newly added Sep. 25, 2015; Dec. 1, 2017; Nov. 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 응시자사진(가로 3.5센티미터 × 세로 4.5센티미터 규격으로 응시원서 제출 전 6개월 이내에 모자를 쓰지 아니하고 찍은 상반신 사진을 말한다. 이하 같다) 2장
rows.text_en: 1. Two photographs of the applicant (referring to a head-and-shoulder photograph taken without a hat within six months prior to the submission of the application, measuring 3.5 cm wide × 4.5 cm high. The same applies hereinafter).

rows.source_ko: 2. 제37조제1항에 해당하는 경우에는 그 증명서 1부
rows.text_en: 2. In cases falling under Article 37, Paragraph 1, one copy of the certificate

rows.source_ko: 3. 제38조제2항에 해당하는 경우에는 제39조제6항에 따른 과목합격증명서 1부
rows.text_en: 3. In cases falling under Article 38, Paragraph 2, one copy of the Certificate of Passing a Subject pursuant to Article 39, Paragraph 6

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 응시원서를 받은 위원장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 주민등록표 초본을 확인하여야 하고, 응시자가 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 해당 서류(사본인 경우 원본과 대조하는 등의 방법으로 그 진위를 확인할 수 있는 것이어야 한다)를 첨부하게 하여야 한다. 다만, 응시자가 응시원서를 제출하면서 신분증을 제시하는 경우에는 해당 신분증의 확인으로 주민등록표 초본의 확인을 갈음할 수 있다. <개정 2017. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: ② The Chairperson who receives the application form pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall verify the abstract of the resident registration record through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act; if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the Chairperson shall require the attachment of the relevant document (in the case of a copy, it must be one whose authenticity can be verified by methods such as comparison with the original). However, if the applicant presents an identification card when submitting the application form, the verification of said identification card may substitute for the verification of the abstract of the resident registration record. <Amended Dec. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ③ 중졸검정고시에 응시하려는 사람은 별지 제4호서식에 따른 중학교 졸업학력 검정고시 응시원서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 검정고시위원회의 위원장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25., 2017. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: ③ Any person intending to take the Middle School Equivalency Examination shall submit the application form for the Middle School Graduation Equivalency Examination in accordance with Form No. 4 attached hereto, along with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Chairperson of the Equivalency Examination Committee. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015; Dec. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 졸업증명서, 졸업예정증명서 또는 최종학교 제적증명서 등 최종학력을 증명할 수 있는 서류(초등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격증서 또는 합격증명서는 제외한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of documents proving one's highest level of education, such as a graduation certificate, certificate of expected graduation, or certificate of expulsion from the last school (excluding certificates or proof of passing the elementary school equivalency examination).

rows.source_ko: 2. 응시자사진 2장
rows.text_en: 2. Two applicant photos

rows.source_ko: 3. 제37조제2항제2호에 해당하는 경우에는 그 증명서 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of the certificate in cases falling under Article 37, Paragraph 2, Subparagraph 2

rows.source_ko: 4. 제38조제2항에 해당하는 경우에는 제39조제6항에 따른 과목합격증명서 1부
rows.text_en: 4. In cases falling under Article 38, Paragraph 2, one copy of the Certificate of Passing a Subject pursuant to Article 39, Paragraph 6

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따라 응시원서를 받은 위원장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 주민등록표 초본 및 초등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격증명서를 확인하여야 하고, 응시자가 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 해당 서류(초등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격증명서의 경우에는 초등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격증서 또는 합격증명서를 말하며, 사본인 경우 원본과 대조하는 등의 방법으로 그 진위를 확인할 수 있는 것이어야 한다)를 첨부하게 하여야 한다. 다만, 응시자가 응시원서를 제출하면서 신분증을 제시하는 경우에는 해당 신분증의 확인으로 주민등록표 초본의 확인을 갈음할 수 있다. <개정 2017. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Chairperson who receives the application form pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall verify the abstract of the resident registration record and the certificate of passing the elementary school equivalency examination through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act ; if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the Chairperson shall require the applicant to attach the relevant documents (in the case of the certificate of passing the elementary school equivalency examination, this refers to the certificate of passing or the certificate of passing the elementary school equivalency examination; in the case of a copy, it must be one whose authenticity can be verified by methods such as comparison with the original). However, if the applicant presents an identification card when submitting the application form, the verification of said identification card may substitute for the verification of the abstract of the resident registration record. <Amended Dec. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 고졸검정고시에 응시하려는 사람(제37조제3항제5호에 해당하여 전 과목의 시험이 면제되는 사람을 포함한다)은 별지 제5호서식의 고등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 응시원서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 검정고시위원회의 위원장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25., 2017. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ A person intending to take the High School Equivalency Examination ( including those exempted from the examination for all subjects under Article 37, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 5 ) shall submit the application form for the High School Equivalency Examination ( Form No. 5 ) to the Chairperson of the Equivalency Examination Committee, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015; Dec. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 졸업증명서, 졸업예정증명서, 수료증명서 또는 최종학교 제적증명서 등 최종학력을 증명할 수 있는 서류(중학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격증서 또는 합격증명서는 제외한다) 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of a document proving one's highest level of education, such as a graduation certificate, certificate of expected graduation, certificate of completion, or certificate of expulsion from the last school (excluding certificates or passing certificates of the middle school equivalency examination).

rows.source_ko: 2. 응시자사진 2장
rows.text_en: 2. Two applicant photos

rows.source_ko: 3. 제37조제3항제2호, 제4호 또는 제5호 중 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 그 증명서 1부
rows.text_en: 3. One copy of the certificate in cases falling under any of Article 37, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraphs 2 , 4 , or 5.

rows.source_ko: 4. 제38조제2항에 해당하는 경우에는 제39조제6항에 따른 과목합격증명서 1부
rows.text_en: 4. In cases falling under Article 38, Paragraph 2, one copy of the Certificate of Passing a Subject pursuant to Article 39, Paragraph 6

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제5항에 따라 응시원서를 받은 위원장은 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 다음 각 호의 서류를 확인하여야 하고, 응시자가 확인에 동의하지 아니하는 경우에는 해당 서류(제2호의 경우에는 장애인등록증 또는 장애인증명서, 제3호의 경우에는 기능사 이상 자격수첩 또는 기능사 이상 자격 최종시험 합격증명서, 제4호의 경우에는 중학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격증서 또는 합격증명서를 말하며, 사본인 경우 원본과 대조하는 등의 방법으로 그 진위를 확인할 수 있는 것이어야 한다)를 첨부하게 하여야 한다. 다만, 응시자가 응시원서를 제출하면서 신분증을 제시하는 경우에는 해당 신분증의 확인으로 주민등록표 초본의 확인을 갈음할 수 있다. <개정 2015. 9. 25., 2017. 12. 1.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Chairperson who receives the application form pursuant to Paragraph 5 shall verify the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act; if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the Chairperson shall require the applicant to attach the relevant documents (referring to a disability registration card or disability certificate in the case of Subparagraph 2; a qualification booklet for a skilled worker or higher or a certificate of passing the final examination for a skilled worker or higher qualification in the case of Subparagraph 3; and a certificate of passing the middle school equivalency examination or a certificate of passing in the case of Subparagraph 4; in the case of a copy, it must be one whose authenticity can be verified by methods such as comparison with the original). However, if the applicant presents an identification card when submitting the application form, the verification of said identification card may substitute for the verification of the abstract of the resident registration record. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015; Dec. 1, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 1. 주민등록표 초본
rows.text_en: 1. Abstract of Resident Registration

rows.source_ko: 2. 장애인증명서(제35조제6항제2호 단서에 해당하는 경우에만 확인한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Certificate of Disability ( verified only in cases falling under the proviso of Article 35, Paragraph 6, Subparagraph 2 )

rows.source_ko: 3. 국가기술자격증(제37조제3항제3호 또는 제5호에 해당하는 경우에만 확인한다)
rows.text_en: 3. National Technical Qualification Certificate ( Verification required only in cases falling under Article 37, Paragraph 3 , Subparagraph 3 or 5)

rows.source_ko: 4. 중학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격증명서
rows.text_en: 4. Certificate of Passing the Middle School Equivalency Examination

rows.source_ko: 제37조(시험과목의 면제) ① 만 18세 이후에 「평생교육법」 제23조제2항에 따라 평가인정한 학습과정 중 시험과목에 관련된 과정을 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 90시간 이상 이수한 초졸검정고시 응시자에 대해서는 본인이 원하는 경우 제33조제1항의 시험과목 중 해당 이수과정과 관련된 과목(국어ㆍ수학을 제외한다)을 면제한다. <신설 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 37 (Exemption from Examination Subjects) ① For applicants for the Elementary School Equivalency Examination who, after the age of 18,of a course related to the examination subjects among learning courses evaluated and accredited pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Lifelong Education Act, as prescribed by the Minister of Education, the subjects related to the completed course among the examination subjects under Article 33 , Paragraph 1 (excluding Korean and Mathematics) shall be exemptedif they so desire . <Newly added Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 다음 각 호에 해당하는 중졸검정고시 응시자에 대해서는 본인이 원하는 경우 제33조제2항의 시험과목 중 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 과목의 시험을 면제한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② Candidates for the Middle School Equivalency Examination falling under any of the following subparagraphs shall be exempted from the examination for subjects classified according to the following subparagraphs among the examination subjects under Article 33, Paragraph 2, if they so desire. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 3년제 고등공민학교 및 중학교에 준하는 각종학교의 졸업자 또는 졸업예정자: 국어ㆍ수학ㆍ영어를 제외한 과목
rows.text_en: 1. Graduates or prospective graduates of 3-year higher civic schools and various schools equivalent to middle schools: Subjects excluding Korean, Mathematics, and English

rows.source_ko: 2. 만 18세 이후에 「평생교육법」 제23조제2항에 따라 평가인정한 학습과정 중 시험과목에 관련된 과정을 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 90시간 이상 이수한 사람: 국어ㆍ수학ㆍ영어를 제외한 과목 중 해당 이수과정과 관련된 과목
rows.text_en: 2. Persons who, after the age of 18, have completed at least 90 hours of a course related to the examination subject among learning courses evaluated and accredited pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Lifelong Education Act, as determined by the Minister of Education : Subjects related to the completed course among subjects excluding Korean, Mathematics, and English.

rows.source_ko: ③ 다음 각 호에 해당하는 고졸검정고시 응시자에 대해서는 본인이 원하는 경우 제33조제3항의 시험과목 중 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 과목의 시험을 면제한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ③ Candidates for the High School Equivalency Examination falling under any of the following subparagraphs shall be exempted from the examination for subjects classified according to the following subparagraphs among the examination subjects under Article 33, Paragraph 3, if they so desire. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 1. 3년제 고등기술학교 및 고등학교에 준하는 각종학교(이하 “고등기술학교등”이라 한다)의 졸업자 또는 졸업예정자: 국어ㆍ수학ㆍ영어를 제외한 과목
rows.text_en: 1. Graduates or prospective graduates of three-year higher technical schools and various schools equivalent to high schools (hereinafter referred to as “higher technical schools, etc.”): Subjects excluding Korean, Mathematics, and English

rows.source_ko: 2. 3년제직업훈련과정의 수료자: 국어ㆍ수학ㆍ영어를 제외한 과목
rows.text_en: 2. Graduates of the 3-year vocational training course: Subjects excluding Korean, Mathematics, and English

rows.source_ko: 3. 제1호 또는 제2호에 해당하는 사람으로서 「국가기술자격법」에 따른 기능사 이상의 자격을 취득한 사람: 국어와 수학 또는 국어와 영어를 제외한 과목
rows.text_en: 3. A person falling under Subparagraph 1 or 2 who has obtained a Craftsman qualification or higher under the National Technical Qualifications Act : Subjects excluding Korean and Mathematics or Korean and English

rows.source_ko: 4. 만 18세 이후에 「평생교육법」 제23조제2항에 따라 평가인정한 학습과정 중 시험과목에 관련된 과정을 교육부장관이 정하는 바에 따라 90시간 이상 이수한 사람: 국어ㆍ수학ㆍ영어를 제외한 과목 중 해당 이수과정과 관련된 과목
rows.text_en: 4. Persons who, after the age of 18, have completed at least 90 hours of a course related to the examination subject among learning courses evaluated and accredited pursuant to Article 23, Paragraph 2 of the Lifelong Education Act, as determined by the Minister of Education : Subjects related to the completed course among subjects excluding Korean, Mathematics, and English.

rows.source_ko: 5. 고등기술학교등의 최종학년 재학 중 또는 3년제직업훈련과정의 최종 이수년 이수 중에 국어와 수학 또는 국어와 영어 과목에 합격하고, 졸업 또는 수료 후 3년 이내에 「국가기술자격법」에 따른 기능사 이상의 자격을 취득한 사람: 전 과목
rows.text_en: 5. Persons who passed the Korean and Mathematics or Korean and English subjects while enrolled in the final year of a higher technical school, etc., or during the final year of a 3-year vocational training course, and who obtained a Craftsman qualification or higher under the National Technical Qualifications Act within 3 years after graduation or completion : All subjects

rows.source_ko: 제38조(합격 결정 등) ① 검정고시는 각 과목을 100점 만점으로 하여 전 과목 평균 60점 이상을 합격으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 38 (Determination of Pass, etc.) ① For the Equivalency Examination, each subject is graded out of 100 points, and an average of 60 points or higher across all subjects is considered a passing score.

rows.source_ko: ② 시험 성적 60점 이상인 과목에 대해서는 과목합격을 인정하고, 본인이 원하면 다음 회의 시험부터 해당 과목의 시험을 면제하고 그 면제되는 과목의 성적을 시험 성적에 합산한다.
rows.text_en: ② For subjects with a test score of 60 points or higher, the subject is recognized as passed, and if the student wishes, the test for that subject is waived starting from the next test, and the score of the waived subject is added to the test score.

rows.source_ko: ③ 2015년 이전 고졸검정고시 응시자 중 선택Ⅱ 과목합격자가 고졸검정고시 합격결정을 위한 성적산정에 선택Ⅱ 과목 성적의 반영을 원하는 경우 선택Ⅱ 과목의 성적을 합산하여 합격결정을 위한 성적을 산정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Among those who took the high school equivalency exam before 2015, if a person who passed the Elective II subject wishes to have the score of the Elective II subject reflected in the score calculation for determining the pass of the high school equivalency exam, the score of the Elective II subject is added up to calculate the score for determining the pass.

rows.source_ko: 제39조(합격증서의 수여 등) ① 초졸검정고시에 합격한 사람에게는 별지 제5호의2서식에 따른 합격증서를 수여하고, 신청(정보통신망에 의한 신청을 포함한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다)에 따라 별지 제5호의3서식(영문본을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제5호의4서식)에 따른 성적증명서 및 별지 제5호의5서식(영문본을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제5호의6서식)에 따른 합격증명서를 발급한다. <신설 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 39 (Conferment of Certificate of Passing, etc.) ① A person who has passed the elementary school equivalency examinationshall be conferred a certificate of passing in accordance with Form No. 5-2 of the Appendix, and upon application (including an application via an information and communications network; hereinafter the same applies in this Article), a certificate of grades in accordance with Form No. 5-3 of the Appendix ( Form No. 5-4 if an English version is requested) and a certificate of passing in accordance with Form No. 5-5 of the Appendix ( Form No. 5-6 if an English version is requested) shall be issued. <Newly added Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 중졸검정고시에 합격한 사람에게는 별지 제6호서식에 따른 합격증서를 수여하고, 신청에 따라 별지 제7호서식(영문본을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제8호서식)에 따른 성적증명서 및 별지 제9호서식(영문본을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제10호서식)에 따른 합격증명서를 발급한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ② Persons who have passed the middle school equivalency examination shall be awarded a certificate of passing in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form , and upon application, a certificate of academic performance in accordance with Form No. 7 ( Form No. 8 if an English version is requested ) and a certificate of passing in accordance with Form No. 9 ( Form No. 10 if an English version is requested ) shall be issued. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ③ 고졸검정고시에 합격한 사람에게는 별지 제11호서식에 따른 합격증서를 수여하고, 신청에 따라 별지 제12호서식(영문본을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제13호서식)에 따른 성적증명서, 별지 제14호서식(영문본을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제15호서식)에 따른 합격증명서 및 별지 제14호의2서식에 따른 합격증명서(대입전형용)를 발급한다. 다만, 2015년도 이전 고졸검정고시에 합격한 사람 또는 제38조제3항에 따라 2015년도 이전 고졸검정고시의 선택Ⅱ 과목의 성적을 합산 반영하여 고졸검정고시에 합격한 사람이 성적증명서의 발급을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제16호서식(영문본을 신청한 경우에는 별지 제17호서식)에 따른 성적증명서를 발급한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25., 2024. 11. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ A certificate of passing in accordance with Form No. 11 of the Attached Form shall be awarded to a person who has passed the high school equivalency examination , and upon application, a transcript of scores in accordance with Form No. 12 of the Attached Form ( Form No. 13 if an English version is requested ), a certificate of passing in accordance with Form No. 14 of the Attached Form (Form No. 15 if an English version is requested ), and a certificate of passing (for university entrance examination) in accordance with Form No. 14-2 of the Attached Form shall be issued. However, if a person who passed the high school equivalency examination prior to 2015, or a person who passed the high school equivalency examination by reflecting the combined scores of the Elective II subjects of the high school equivalency examination prior to 2015 pursuant to Article 38, Paragraph 3, applies for the issuance of a transcript of scores, a transcript of scores in accordance with Form No. 16 of the Attached Form ( Form No. 17 if an English version is requested ) shall be issued. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015; Nov. 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ④ 3년제 고등공민학교 또는 중학교에 준하는 각종학교의 졸업예정자로서 제37조제2항에 따라 과목 면제를 받아 중졸검정고시에 합격한 사람에 대해서는 그가 졸업할 때까지 합격증서의 수여 또는 성적증명서의 발급을 보류하고 그가 졸업하지 못하였을 경우에는 중졸검정고시에 응시한 과목에 대한 과목합격으로 인정한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ④ For a person who is a prospective graduate of a three-year higher civic school or various schools equivalent to a middle school and who has passed the middle school equivalency examination after receiving subject exemptions pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 2, the awarding of a certificate of passing or the issuance of a transcript shall be withheld until graduation; if such person fails to graduate, the passing of the subjects taken in the middle school equivalency examination shall be recognized. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 고등기술학교등의 졸업예정자로서 제37조제3항에 따라 과목 면제를 받아 고졸검정고시에 합격한 사람에 대해서는 그가 졸업할 때까지 합격증서의 수여 또는 성적증명서의 발급을 보류하고 그가 졸업하지 못하였을 경우에는 고졸검정고시에 응시한 과목에 대한 과목합격으로 인정한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ For a person who is a prospective graduate of a higher technical school, etc., and who has passed the high school equivalency examination after receiving a subject exemption pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 3, the awarding of a certificate of passing or the issuance of a transcript shall be withheld until such person graduates; if such person fails to graduate, the person shall be recognized as having passed the subjects for which they took the high school equivalency examination. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 검정고시의 과목합격자에게는 신청에 따라 초졸검정고시의 경우에는 별지 제17호의2서식, 중졸검정고시의 경우에는 별지 제18호서식, 고졸검정고시의 경우에는 별지 제19호서식에 따른 과목합격증명서를 각각 발급한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Upon application, a Certificate of Subject Pass shall be issued to those who have passed the subjects of the Equivalency Examination, in accordance with Form No. 17-2 for the Elementary School Equivalency Examination, Form No. 18 for the Middle School Equivalency Examination, and Form No. 19 for the High School Equivalency Examination, respectively. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 검정고시에 합격한 사람의 수험번호는 시ㆍ도의 공보 또는 시ㆍ도 교육청의 인터넷 홈페이지에 게재한다. 다만, 제4항 또는 제5항에 해당되는 사람에 대해서는 그가 졸업할 때까지 그 게재를 보류한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ The examination number of a person who has passed the GED shall be published in the official gazette of the city or province or on the internet homepage of the city or provincial office of education. However, for persons falling under Paragraph 4 or 5, such publication shall be withheld until they graduate. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑧ 검정고시위원회의 위원장은 전 과목 합격자의 학력을 합격자 발표일부터 80일 이내에 조회ㆍ확인하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ The Chairperson of the Equivalency Examination Committee shall inquire into and verify the academic qualifications of those who have passed all subjects within 80 days from the date of the announcement of successful candidates. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ⑨ 검정고시위원회 위원장은 제8항에 따른 학력 조회 결과 학력과 관련하여 거짓을 발견하였을 때에는 지체 없이 합격을 취소하여야 한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: ⑨ If the Chairperson of the Equivalency Examination Committee discovers any falsehood regarding academic qualifications as a result of the academic qualification inquiry pursuant to Paragraph 8, the Chairperson shall revoke the passing without delay. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: 제40조(부정행위자에 대한 조치) ① 검정고시에서 부정한 행위를 한 사람 또는 응시와 관련한 서류를 위조한 사람에 대해서는 그 시험을 정지시키고, 그 후 2년간 검정고시에 응시하지 못하게 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 40 (Measures against Persons Who Committed Fraud) ① Any person who commits fraudulent acts in the GED or who forges documents related to the application may have their examination suspended and be prohibited from taking the GED for two years thereafter.

rows.source_ko: ② 합격(과목합격을 포함한다) 후 제1항의 사실이 발각되었을 때에는 그 합격을 취소하고, 이미 발급한 증서 또는 증명서가 무효임을 관보에 게재하거나 그 밖의 방법을 통하여 공고한다.
rows.text_en: ② If the facts under Paragraph 1 are discovered after passing (including passing a subject), the passing shall be revoked, and the fact that the certificate or proof already issued is invalid shall be announced in the Official Gazette or through other means.

rows.source_ko: 제41조(합격증서의 기재사항 변경 등) ① 합격증서를 받은 사람은 합격증서의 기재사항을 변경하거나 합격증서를 재발급 받아야 할 정당한 사유가 있는 경우에는 별지 제20호서식의 검정고시 합격증서 기재사항 변경 신청서 또는 별지 제21호서식의 검정고시 합격증서 재발급 신청서에 그 사유를 구체적으로 밝혀 해당 검정고시위원회의 위원장에게 합격증서의 기재사항 변경 또는 재발급을 신청(정보통신망에 의한 신청을 포함한다)할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 41 (Change of details on certificate of passing, etc.) ① If a person who has received a certificate of passing has a justifiable reason to change the details on the certificate of passing or to have the certificate reissued, they may apply to the chairperson of the relevant examination committee for the change of details on the certificate of passing or the reissuance of the certificate of passing by specifying the reason in the application for change of details on the certificate of passing in Form No. 20 or the application for reissuance of the certificate of passing in Form No. 21 (including an application via an information and communication network).

rows.source_ko: ② 검정고시위원회의 위원장은 합격자가 개명(改名)을 이유로 제1항의 신청을 한 경우에는 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통하여 신청인의 주민등록표 초본을 확인하여야 한다. 다만, 신청인이 확인에 동의하지 않는 경우에는 그 서류를 첨부하게 하고, 주민등록표 초본의 확인으로 개명 여부를 확인하기 어려운 경우에는 가족관계기록에 관한 증명서(기본증명서를 말한다)를 첨부하게 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If a successful candidate applies under Paragraph 1 on the grounds of a name change, the Chairperson of the Board of Eligibility for Examinations shall verify the applicant’s resident registration abstract through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act . However, if the applicant does not consent to the verification, the applicant shall be required to attach the relevant document, and if it is difficult to verify whether a name has been changed through the verification of the resident registration abstract, the applicant shall be required to attach a certificate regarding family relationship records (referring to a basic certificate).

rows.source_ko: ③ 검정고시위원회의 위원장은 고졸검정고시를 합격한 사람의 신청이 있는 경우에는 별지 제12호서식 또는 별지 제16호서식에 따른 성적증명서와 별지 제14호서식 또는 별지 제14호의2서식에 따른 합격증명서를 고졸검정고시를 합격한 사람이 진학하고자 하는 상급학교에 교육정보시스템을 통하여 정보통신망으로 제공할 수 있다. 이 경우 신청은 위원장이 정하는 바에 따라 교육정보시스템을 통하여 하여야 한다. <개정 2024. 11. 14.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon application by a person who has passed the High School Equivalency Examination, the Chairperson of the Equivalency Examination Committee may provide a certificate of academic performance in accordance with Form No. 12 or Form No. 16 and a certificate of passing in accordance with Form No. 14 or Form No. 14-2 to the higher school to which the person wishes to advance, via an information and communication network through the Education Information System. In this case, the application must be made through the Education Information System as determined by the Chairperson. <Amended Nov. 14, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제42조(수수료) ① 시험 응시 수수료 및 검정고시에 따르는 각종 증명서의 발급 수수료에 관하여 필요한 사항은 시ㆍ도의 조례로 정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 42 (Fees) ① Matters necessary for examination application fees and fees for the issuance of various certificates pursuant to the qualification examination shall be determined by ordinances of cities and provinces .

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 「국민기초생활보장법」에 의한 수급자와 「한부모가족지원법」에 따른 지원대상자는 검정고시 응시수수료를 면제한다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, recipients under the National Basic Living Security Act and beneficiaries under the Single Parent Family Support Act shall be exempt from the examination fee for the GED.

rows.source_ko: 제43조(서류 및 수수료의 반환) ① 제36조제1항ㆍ제3항 및 제5항에 따라 제출된 서류는 반환하지 아니한다. <개정 2015. 9. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 43 (Return of Documents and Fees) ①Documents submitted pursuant to Article 36 , Paragraphs 1 , 3 , and 5 shall not be returned. <Amended Sep. 25, 2015>

rows.source_ko: ② 응시자가 수수료를 잘못 내거나 불가피한 사유로 시험에 응시하지 못하는 등 정당한 사유가 인정되는 경우에는 시ㆍ도 조례에서 정하는 바에 따라 납부된 수수료의 전부 또는 일부를 반환받을 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If a valid reason is recognized, such as when an applicant pays the fee incorrectly or is unable to take the exam due to unavoidable circumstances, the applicant may receive a refund of all or part of the fee paid in accordance with the city or provincial ordinance .

rows.source_ko: 제44조(대장의 비치) 검정고시위원회의 위원장은 별지 제21호의2서식에 따른 초등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격자대장, 별지 제21호의3서식에 따른 초등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 성적대장, 별지 제22호서식에 따른 중학교 졸업학력 검정고시 합격자대장, 별지 제23호서식에 따른 중학교 졸업학력 검정고시 성적대장, 별지 제24호서식에 따른 고등학교 졸업학력검정고시 합격자대장 및 별지 제25호서식에 따른 고등학교 졸업학력 검정고시 성적대장을 작성하여 검정고시위원회에 갖추어 두어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 44 (Keeping of Registers) The Chairperson of the Equivalency Examination Committee shall prepare and keep at the Equivalency Examination Committee the register of successful candidates for the elementary school graduation equivalency examination in accordance with Form No. 21-2 , the register of grades for the elementary school graduation equivalency examination in accordance with Form No. 21-3 , the register of successful candidates for the middle school graduation equivalency examination in accordance with Form No. 22 , the register of grades for the middle school graduation equivalency examination in accordance with Form No. 23 , the register of successful candidates for the high school graduation equivalency examinationin accordance with Form No. 24, and the register of grades for the high school graduation equivalency examination in accordance with Form No. 25 .
[Wholly Amended Sep. 25, 2015]

rows.source_ko: 제2절의2 학교의 시설ㆍ설비ㆍ교구 <신설 2021. 9. 24.>
rows.text_en: Section 2-2 School Facilities, Equipment, and Teaching Aids <Newly Inserted Sep. 24, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 제44조의2(시설ㆍ설비ㆍ교구 점검의 대상, 방법, 시기 등) 법 제30조의9제1항에 따른 학교의 시설ㆍ설비ㆍ교구 점검의 대상, 방법, 시기 등은 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 44-2 (Objects, Methods, Timing, etc. of Inspection of Facilities, Equipment, and Teaching Aids) The objects, methods, timing, etc. of inspection of school facilities, equipment, and teaching aids pursuant to Article 30-9, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be as classified in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 시설ㆍ설비: 「교육시설 등의 안전 및 유지관리 등에 관한 법률」 제10조, 제13조 및 제14조에 따른 교육시설의 안전ㆍ유지관리기준의 준수 여부 점검, 안전점검 및 정밀안전진단의 대상, 방법, 시기 등에 따른다.
rows.text_en: 1. Facilities and Equipment: Subjects, methods, timing, etc. of safety inspections and detailed safety diagnoses, as well as inspections of compliance with safety and maintenance standards for educational facilities pursuant to Articles 10 , 13 , and 14 of the Act on Safety and Maintenance of Educational Facilities, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 교구: 점검의 시기는 다음 각 목의 구분에 따르고, 점검의 방법 등 점검에 필요한 세부사항은 학교의 장이 정한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Diocese: The timing of inspections shall follow the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs, and the head of the school shall determine the details necessary for inspection, such as the inspection method.

rows.source_ko: 가. 모든 교과에 공통으로 사용되는 수업용 시청각 장비, 칠판, 책상, 걸상: 매년 1회 이상
rows.text_en: a. Audiovisual equipment, blackboards, desks, and chairs used in common across all subjects: at least once a year

rows.source_ko: 나. 가목 외의 교구: 학교의 장이 정하는 시기
rows.text_en: B. Dioceses other than those in Item A: A time determined by the head of the school
[This Article Newly Inserted Sep. 24, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제3절 학교운영위원회 등 <개정 2026. 3. 11.>
rows.text_en: Section 3 School Steering Committee, etc. <Amended Mar. 11, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 제44조의3(범죄경력 등 조회 대상자의 동의서) 영 제57조의3제2항에 따른 범죄경력 등 조회 대상자의 동의서는 별지 제25호의2서식과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 44-3 (Consent Form for Persons Subject to Inquiry into Criminal Record, etc.) The consent form for persons subject to an inquiry into criminal record, etc. pursuant to Article 57-3, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree is as shown in Form No. 25-2 of the Attached Form .
[This Article Newly Inserted Mar. 11, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제45조(학교발전기금회계의 설치 등) ① 법 제31조에 따른 학교운영위원회(이하 “운영위원회”라 한다)가 법 제33조제1항에 따라 학교발전기금(이하 “기금”이라 한다)을 조성하는 경우에는 학교발전기금회계(이하 “회계”라 한다)를 별도로 설치하여 관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 45 (Establishment of School Development Fund Accounting, etc.) ①When a school management committee pursuant to Article 31 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Management Committee”) establishes a school development fund (hereinafter referred to as the “Fund”) pursuant to Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall separately establish and manage a school development fund accounting (hereinafter referred to as the “Accounting”).

rows.source_ko: ② 기금의 수입은 영 제64조제1항 각 호에 따른 금품과 그 운용으로 발생하는 수익으로 하고, 기금의 지출은 영 제64조제2항 각 호의 목적을 위한 비용 및 기금의 운용에 필요한 경비로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The income of the Fund shall consist of money and valuables pursuant to each subparagraph of Article 64, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree and profits generated from their operation, and the expenditure of the Fund shall consist of expenses for the purposes specified in each subparagraph of Article 64, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree and expenses necessary for the operation of the Fund.

rows.source_ko: ③ 기금의 모든 수입은 세입ㆍ세출예산에 계상(計上)하여야 하며, 직접 사용할 수 없다.
rows.text_en: ③ All revenue of the fund must be accounted for in the revenue and expenditure budget and may not be used directly.

rows.source_ko: ④ 1회계연도의 모든 수입은 세입으로 하고, 모든 지출은 세출로 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ All income for one fiscal year shall be revenue, and all expenditure shall be expenditure.

rows.source_ko: 제46조(기금운용계획의 수립 등) 운영위원회 위원장은 회계연도마다 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 기금운용계획을 수립하고 운영위원회의 심의를 거쳐 시행하여야 한다. 기금운용계획을 변경하려는 경우에도 또한 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 46 (Establishment of Fund Management Plan, etc.) The Chairperson of the Steering Committee shall establish a fund management plan for each fiscal year that includes the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs and implement it after deliberation by the Steering Committee. The same shall apply when intending to amend the fund management plan.

rows.source_ko: 1. 사업 목적
rows.text_en: 1. Business Objective

rows.source_ko: 2. 기금 조성방법
rows.text_en: 2. Method of Fundraising

rows.source_ko: 3. 수입 및 지출 계획
rows.text_en: 3. Income and Expense Plan

rows.source_ko: 4. 그 밖에 기금의 운용 및 관리에 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Other matters necessary for the operation and management of the fund

rows.source_ko: 제47조(기금의 운용) 운영위원회는 기금 및 기금으로부터 발생하는 수익금을 금융회사 또는 체신관서에 예탁하는 방법으로 운용하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 47 (Operation of Fund) The Operating Committee shall operate the Fund and the proceeds generated from the Fund by depositing them with a financial institution or a postal office.

rows.source_ko: 제47조의2(정보처리장치에 따른 회계의 처리) 기금의 회계에 속하는 예산ㆍ결산 및 회계 업무는 교육부장관이 지정하는 정보처리장치로 처리해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 47-2 (Processing of Accounting by Information Processing Device) Budget, settlement of accounts, and accounting affairs belonging to the accounting of the Fund shall be processed by an information processing device designated by the Minister of Education.
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 8, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제48조(회계연도) 기금의 회계연도는 매년 3월 1일부터 다음 연도 2월 말일까지로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 48 (Fiscal Year) The fiscal year of the Fund shall be from March 1 of each year to the last day of February of the following year.

rows.source_ko: 제48조의2(출납폐쇄기한) 기금의 출납은 회계연도 종료 후 20일이 되는 날에 폐쇄한다.
rows.text_en: Article 48-2 (Closing Date) The disbursement of funds shall be closed on the 20th day after the end of the fiscal year.
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 8, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제49조(회계방법) 기금의 회계는 복식부기 방식으로 처리한다.
rows.text_en: Article 49 (Accounting Method) The accounting of the Fund shall be conducted using the double-entry bookkeeping method.

rows.source_ko: 제50조(결산보고) 운영위원회 위원장은 영 제64조제8항에 따라 회계연도마다 기금의 결산에 관한 다음 각 호의 서류를 작성하여 운영위원회의 심의를 거쳐 그 결과를 법 제6조에 따른 지도ㆍ감독기관에 보고하고, 학부모에게 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 50 (Report on Settlement of Accounts) In accordance with Article 64, Paragraph 8 of the Enforcement Decree, the Chairpersonof the Steering Committee shall prepare the following documents regarding the settlement of accounts of the fund for each fiscal year, report the results to the supervisory authority pursuant to Article 6 of the Act after deliberation by the Steering Committee, and notify the parents.

rows.source_ko: 1. 결산의 개황(槪況) 및 분석에 관한 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents concerning the overview and analysis of the settlement of accounts

rows.source_ko: 2. 수입 및 지출 계산서
rows.text_en: 2. Statement of Income and Expenses

rows.source_ko: 3. 예탁금 잔액증명서
rows.text_en: 3. Deposit Balance Certificate

rows.source_ko: 제51조(잉여금의 처리) 기금의 결산 결과 잉여금이 생겼을 때에는 다음 회계연도의 세입으로 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 51 (Treatment of Surplus) If a surplus arises as a result of the settlement of accounts of the fund, it shall be treated as revenue for the next fiscal year.

rows.source_ko: 제52조(장부 등의 비치 및 관리) ① 운영위원회는 기금의 접수 상황 및 사용 내용 등을 나타내는 다음 각 호의 서류와 장부를 갖추어 두고 관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 52 (Keeping and Management of Books, etc.) ① The Steering Committee shall keep and manage the following documents and books indicating the status of fund receipt and usage, etc.

rows.source_ko: 1. 별지 제26호서식에 따른 학교발전기금 운용계획서
rows.text_en: 1. School Development Fund Operation Plan pursuant to Form No. 26

rows.source_ko: 2. 별지 제27호서식에 따른 학교발전기금 기탁서
rows.text_en: 2. School Development Fund Donation Form according to Attached Form No. 27

rows.source_ko: 3. 별지 제28호서식에 따른 학교발전기금 접수대장
rows.text_en: 3. School Development Fund Receipt Register in accordance with Form No. 28

rows.source_ko: 4. 별지 제29호서식에 따른 학교발전기금 출납부
rows.text_en: 4. School Development Fund Ledger in accordance with Form No. 29

rows.source_ko: 5. 별지 제30호서식에 따른 학교발전기금회계 결산보고서
